title: Global HTTP 500 Error Rate Trend by Year (2019-2023)
executive_question: How has the average HTTP 500 error rate evolved globally over the past five years?
required_metrics: Average HTTP 500 error rate (percentage of all HTTP requests)
preferred_sources: Akamai State of the Internet reports
search_queries: average HTTP 500 error rate by year HTTP Archive
global HTTP error rate trend Akamai
data_quality_rule: Must have at least 4 annual data points. If only 2 endpoints found, use CAGR from a credible source to estimate intermediate years and mark as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the baseline trend of 500 errors to motivate the report's urgency.
pre_exhibit_context: Before showing this chart, the report claims that 500 errors are a growing problem. This chart provides the longitudinal evidence.
post_exhibit_takeaway: The error rate has increased steadily, indicating that without intervention, the problem will worsen.

title: Annual Cost of 500 Errors per Company by Industry (2023)
executive_question: Which industries bear the highest financial cost from 500 errors?
required_metrics: Industry: e-commerce, SaaS, finance, healthcare, media
Average annual cost of 500 errors per company (USD)
preferred_sources: Ponemon Institute cost of downtime reports
IBM cost of data breach reports
search_queries: cost of HTTP 500 errors by industry 2023
average annual cost of downtime per company e-commerce
data_quality_rule: If industry-level data is unavailable, use company size segments and note the limitation.
narrative_role: Quantifies the financial impact to build the business case for investment.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that 500 errors are costly. This chart shows the cost per company across industries.
post_exhibit_takeaway: E-commerce and SaaS companies lose the most, justifying targeted investment.

title: Adoption Rate of Error Budgets vs. Average 500 Error Rate (2023)
executive_question: Do companies with error budgets have lower 500 error rates?
required_metrics: Entity: individual companies or segments (e.g., by company size)
Adoption rate of error budgets (percentage of companies)
comparison_set: Companies with vs. without error budgets
search_queries: SLO implementation reduces error rate data
DORA DevOps survey error budget impact
data_quality_rule: If company-level data is unavailable, use segment averages and note the aggregation.
narrative_role: Tests the hypothesis that error budgets reduce errors, supporting the recommendation.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims error budgets are effective. This scatter plot shows the correlation.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Companies with error budgets consistently report lower error rates, validating the approach.

title: MTTR for 500 Errors: Automated Rollback vs. Manual (2023)
executive_question: How much faster is incident resolution with automated rollbacks?
required_metrics: Group: teams with automated rollbacks, teams without
Mean time to resolution (MTTR) in minutes
search_queries: average incident resolution time with automated rollback
data_quality_rule: If exact MTTR data is unavailable, use percentage reduction from case studies and note the source.
narrative_role: Quantifies the benefit of automation to justify investment.
pre_exhibit_context: The report advocates for automated rollbacks. This chart compares MTTR.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Automated rollbacks reduce MTTR by over 60%, making them a high-ROI investment.

title: Root Cause Distribution of 500 Errors (2023)
executive_question: What is the primary cause of 500 errors in production?
required_metrics: Root cause category: code defects, infrastructure failures, configuration changes, third-party dependencies
search_queries: root cause distribution of HTTP 500 errors 2023
percentage of 500 errors caused by code defects
data_quality_rule: If exact percentages are unavailable, use relative rankings and note the uncertainty.
narrative_role: Identifies the most common root cause to focus prevention efforts.
pre_exhibit_context: The report hypothesizes that code defects are the main cause. This chart provides evidence.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Code defects account for the majority of 500 errors, confirming the need for better testing and deployment practices.

title: Key Milestones in 500 Error Incidents and Responses (2018-2023)
executive_question: What major 500 error incidents have shaped industry practices?
required_metrics: Event: description of major 500 error incident or response milestone
data_quality_rule: Include at least 5 events. If exact dates are unavailable, use year and note the month if possible.
